claude.sample_unit: patient education materials (3 retinal conditions x 3 LLMs x 2 prompts, plus ASRS brochures)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM materials with a sixth-grade-level prompt versus general prompt and ASRS brochures
links.effect: Prompt B significantly improved readability across all LLMs relative to ASRS but still exceeded the sixth-grade level. ASRS average grade 14.17; Gemini 11.65, Copilot 11.23, ChatGPT 12.85 (general prompt).
links.quote: Prompt B significantly improved readability across all large language models relative to ASRS but still exceeded the sixth-grade readability level.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient education materials versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Average readability was 14.17 for ASRS brochures and 11.23-12.85 for LLM materials, all well above sixth-grade level.
links.quote: Average readability of Gemini (11.65; P = .005) and Copilot (11.23; P = .003) materials was significantly better than that of ASRS materials (14.17), whereas ChatGPT showed no significant difference (12.85; P = .06).

links.effect: Gemini 11.65 (P = .005) and Copilot 11.23 (P = .003) were better than ASRS 14.17; ChatGPT 12.85 was not significant (P = .06).
links.quote: Average readability of Gemini (11.65; P = .005) and Copilot (11.23; P = .003) materials was significantly better than that of ASRS materials (14.17), whereas ChatGPT showed no significant difference (12.85; P = .06).

links.effect: Prompt B improved readability across all LLMs relative to ASRS but still exceeded the sixth-grade readability level.
links.quote: Prompt B significantly improved readability across all large language models relative to ASRS but still exceeded the sixth-grade readability level.

links.effect: Misinformation was graded using a 5-point Likert scale; no significant differences were observed for misinformation.
links.quote: No significant differences were observed for actionability or misinformation.

links.outcome: readability of generated patient education materials
links.effect: Prompt B improved readability across all models compared to ASRS (14.17) but still exceeded sixth-grade level (Gemini: 11.65, Copilot: 11.23, ChatGPT: 12.85).
links.quote: Prompt B significantly improved readability across all large language models relative to ASRS but still exceeded the sixth-grade readability level.
